full_prompt_en: A finely drafted mixed-media illustration portrays a field naturalist from the waist up against a cream paper background marked with faint geometric diagrams. He wears a soft tan cap, round glasses, a weathered pale jacket, and crossed leather straps. A small red bird perches calmly on his hand near the lower left, its scarlet feathers the strongest color in the image. The figure turns three-quarters toward the viewer, with a thoughtful face and an upright, measured pose. Behind him, delicate construction lines, squares, circles, and spiral-like sketches remain only partly visible, like an unfinished scientific notebook page. The face, hands, and bird are rendered with tightly controlled pencil and fine ink strokes; hatching follows cheekbones, fabric folds, and feather direction. Thin washes of sepia, clay, soft gray, and muted ochre give volume without covering the underlying draftsmanship. The jacket and background share pale values, so darker outlines and warm leather straps separate the figure from the page. Light is soft and even, with small precise highlights on spectacles and face. The composition leaves generous cream space on the left and places most visual weight at center-right. Straight diagram lines contrast with the organic curves of hair, clothing, and bird. The image feels observant, learned, and quietly imaginative, blending the authority of a natural history plate with the intimacy of a personal sketch.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅精细起稿的混合媒介插画在标有淡几何图解的奶油纸背景前描绘一位野外博物学者的半身。他戴柔软棕帽和圆眼镜，穿磨旧浅夹克，肩上交叉皮带。一只小红鸟安静栖在左下附近手上，其猩红羽毛是画面最强的颜色。人物以四分之三角度转向观者，面容若有所思，姿态直立有分寸。身后，纤细构造线、方格、圆和螺旋状草图若隐若现，像未完成的科学笔记页。脸、手和鸟由严格受控的铅笔与细墨线绘出；排线顺着颧骨、衣褶与羽毛方向。棕黄、陶土、柔灰和暗赭的薄罩染赋予体积，却不盖住底层起稿。夹克与背景明度都浅，较深轮廓与暖皮带将人物从纸页中分开。光柔和均匀，眼镜与脸上有小而精确的亮点。构图在左侧留下宽阔奶油空间，主要视觉重量在中右。直线图解对比头发、衣服和鸟的有机曲线。图像善观察、有学识且安静地富想象，把自然史图版的权威与私人速写的亲密结合。
style_prompt_en: Fine pencil and ink draftsmanship remains visible beneath thin sepia and ochre washes on cream paper. Precise hatching follows form and material, while faint straight construction lines, circles, and grids occupy quieter background intervals. Pale cream and warm gray cover broad areas; clay, tobacco, and one concentrated scarlet accent supply hierarchy. Contours are carefully observed but not uniformly heavy, allowing light materials to merge gently with the page. Soft even illumination preserves small marks without strong cast shadow. A compact detailed cluster balances generous open paper, and technical geometry contrasts with curved organic edges. Layers of sketch, line, and transparent color stay distinct enough to reveal the process of making. The finish is scholarly, tactile, and restrained, with a small vivid note animating a largely neutral field.
style_prompt_zh: 细铅笔与墨线起稿在奶油纸上的薄棕黄赭色罩染下仍清楚可见。精确排线顺着形与材质走，淡直构造线、圆和网格占较安静的背景间隔。浅奶油与暖灰覆盖大面积；陶土、烟草和一处集中猩红强调建立层级。轮廓观察仔细却不处处沉重，让浅材质温和并入纸面。柔和均匀照明保留小笔痕，不形成强投影。紧凑细节簇群平衡宽阔开放纸面，技术几何对比弯曲有机边。草图、线和透明色层足够分明，可揭示制作过程。饰面有学术气息、可触且克制，一点鲜活颜色激活大体中性场。
theme_en: A field naturalist holds a red bird before a page of faint technical diagrams
theme_zh: 一位野外博物学者在淡技术图纸前托着红鸟
name: Hans Erni
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
